description: Welcome! A little about us, we're an avid group of young Singaporean teens willing to push the boundaries of spaceflight and launch it into a game made to introduce and get people hooked into the world of aeronautics. If you like Kerbal Space Program, Juno: New Origins or Spaceflight Simulator, then you'll be thrilled with what we're working on and we're excited to bring you into the Ode to Launch!
summary: Ode to Launch (OTL) is a 2D spaceflight mission design game designed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. The game allows players to design and construct rockets, collect science and manage missions by pioneering and going further beyond. It features a 1:10 solar system with many major celestial bodies and physics. Players make meaningful engineering decisions and learn about crucial spaceflight terms and concepts through Rocket School and Tutorials, managing engineering decisions with stability tips, and collect science from every region of the system through equipment like magnetometers, cameras and rovers as there is a lot to explore and discover with over 30 bodies to explore both in unmanned and manned missions with unique benefits. Space Races and Events aim to bring competitiveness to the table by letting players keep improving designs and compete against one another to see who will come out on top, Observatory mode allows players to experiment and chill with Astronomy to appreciate the vastness of the universe, and Ground Control ties everything together to see active missions, mission logs and data. The game aims to make space engineering accessible and entertaining while encouraging creativity and problem-solving through trial and error with limits. At its heart, OTL celebrates the excitement, wonder and joy of seeing something you created take flight and explore the final frontier through Build. Fly. Reach.
details:
Ode to Launch is a 2D spaceflight simulator. It allows players to build rockets, manage astronauts and resources, and simulate space missions across the solar system with endless adventure and replayability with realism.

Our goal is to make aerospace engineering accessible, educational, and enjoyable through experimentation and problem-solving in an all-around game. We considered factors such as gravity, thrust, fuel consumption, atmospheric conditions, scientific accuracy, and accessibility by making it easy to understand and fun to play with so much to explore and see.

We used Claude for coding while our team directed the game’s concept and creative vision.

Ultimately, Ode to Launch celebrates the excitement, wonder, and joy of seeing something you created take flight.

Build. Fly. Reach.
